info.title: VideoForge API
info.description:
Self-hosted video editing, asset-free motion graphics and FFmpeg rendering. The browser Studio and agent API drive the same timeline; no agent-supplied code is executed.

Timeline batch operations (POST /api/projects/{id}/timeline/ops, body {op,args} or {ops:[...]}), documented as GET /api/capabilities reports them:
- add_shape_clip: shape: {type,width?,height?,fill?,stroke?,strokeWidth?,radius?}, id?, start?, duration?, x?, y?, plus transform/keyframe fields
- add_motion_template: template (lower-third|title-card|callout|kinetic-type|countdown|quote-card|split-reveal|progress-bar|stat-highlight|bullet-list|social-handle|chapter-number|starburst); bullet-list takes items[] (1..6), chapter-number takes number, title?, subtitle?, color?, start?, duration? (0.5..60), idPrefix? (stable layer ids: prefix-0, prefix-1, ...)
- stagger_clips: clipIds: [id...] in desired order, delay (0..60 seconds), start?
- add_clip: assetId, track?, start?, inPoint?, outPoint?, plus any clip field
- add_text_clip: text, id?, start?, duration?, plus text and transform fields
- remove_clip: clipId
- ripple_delete: clipId
- duplicate_clip: clipId, start?, dx?, dy? (position offset for the copy)
- trim_clip: clipId, inPoint?, outPoint?
- move_clip: clipId, start?, track?
- split_clip: clipId, at (timeline seconds)
- update_clip: clipId plus any clip field
- swap_asset: clipId, assetId, duration?, inPoint?, outPoint?, keepKeyframes? — replaces the media source of an existing clip (kept id, style, and placement). not supported on text/shape clips.
- set_audio: clipId, volume?, muted?
- add_text: clipId, text
- set_keyframes: clipId, property, keyframes: [{time,value,easing?}] replaces that property; [] clears it
- rig_bake: animation: {name?, length, start?, parts: [{clipId, parentId?, pivotX?, pivotY?}], tracks: {clipId: {x|y|scale|rotation|opacity: [{time,value,easing?}]}}}, start? - bakes an Animator animation (joints and parent/child parts) into ordinary clip keyframes
- rig_pose: clipIds[], any of x, y, scale, rotation, opacity, delay? (0..60), duration? (default 0.8), easing? - moves several clips to a pose together from where they are now
- rig_follow: childId, parentId, pivotX?, pivotY? (joint offset from the parent's centre, fraction of the frame) - the child rides the parent's motion, turning and scaling about the joint
- upsert_keyframe: clipId, property, time, value, easing?
- remove_keyframe: clipId, property, time
- apply_motion: clipId, preset (see motionPresets), duration? (seconds the move takes), delay? (seconds into the clip), strength? (0.1..2, distance/overshoot multiplier)
- apply_motion_sequence: clipIds[], preset, stagger? (default 0.12 s between clips), start?, plus apply_motion's duration/delay/strength. Applies one preset to many clips and offsets their starts
- reverse_animation: clipId - plays every keyframe curve backwards, mirroring each easing
- retime_animation: clipId, duration, delay? - compresses or stretches all keyframes of a clip into one window, keeping relative timing
- add_beat_markers: bpm (20..300), count? (1..100, default 8), start?, every? (markers on every Nth beat), label?, color?
- snap_to_beats: clipIds[], bpm, start? - moves clip starts to the nearest beat
- align_clips: clipIds[], mode (left|center|right|top|middle|bottom|distribute-h|distribute-v) - lines clips up or spreads them evenly across the frame
- snap_to_grid: clipIds[], grid (0.02..0.5, default 0.1) - rounds positions to a grid
- move_layer: clipId, direction (forward|backward|front|back) - changes stacking order within a track via the clip z field
- set_track: track, settings: {muted?, hidden?, locked?}
- add_marker: time, label?, color?
- remove_marker: id
- set_project: fps?, resolution?: {width,height}, background?: #rrggbb, refit? (true refits text, shapes and overlays to the new canvas)
- reorder: order: [clipId...] re-spaces video clips sequentially
- shift_clips: delta (seconds, may be negative), from? (only clips starting at or after), track?, clipIds?
- close_gaps: track? (default video) packs the track's clips end to end in their current order
- update_clips: patch: {any clip field}, plus clipIds? or track? (omit both to hit every clip)
- copy_style: fromClipId, toClipIds: copies transform, color, fades, text style and keyframes (scaled to the target length)
- set_marker: id, time?, label?, color?
- set_transition: clipId, type (none|dissolve|wipe-left|wipe-right|wipe-up|wipe-down|iris|barn-h|barn-v|diamond|wipe-diagonal), duration? (0.1-3, default 0.6), join? (default true: move the clip to touch the previous video clip first). Overlaps the clip with the one before it and moves later video clips up
- animate_code: clipId, expressions: {property: code}, replace? - see codeAnimation
- apply_code_motion: clipId or clipIds[], recipe (see codeAnimation.recipes), speed? (0.1..5), strength? (0.1..3)
- bake_expression: clipId, property?, samples? (2..64, default 48) - converts expressions to linear keyframes
- fit_clip: clipId, mode? (safe|contain|cover|fill, default safe), margin? (0..0.3, default 0.04)
- fit_all: media? (keep|contain|cover|fill), clipIds?, margin? - fits every visual clip inside the frame
- remove_clips: clipIds[] - delete several clips in one step
